```{r}
#| include: true

DT <- data.table(

  b0 = c(-1.7429, 2.6109, 0.1241, -1.4672, -1.7688, -1.4114, -2.8609),
  b1 = c(0.9981, 1.9228, 1.0529, 1.0587, 0.4212, 1.0922, 1.094),
  b2 = c(0, 0, 0, 0, -0.0328, 0, 0),
  "b3(S=1)" = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
  "b3(S=2)" = c(3e-04, 0.0922, -0.2534, -0.2642, 0.2329, -0.3872, -0.3816),
  "b3(S=3)" = c(0.0111, 0.1855, -0.0787, -0.0516, 0.3374, -0.2113, -0.1913),
  "b4(V=0)" = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
  "b4(V=1)"  = c(0.0433, 0.0653, 0.1109, 0.2123, -0.023, 0.3882, 0.4991),
  sdLnI = c(0.1624, 0.5981, 0.5346, 0.6166, 0.709, 1.055, 1.1269)

)

TBL <- DT |> buildTable(library="flextable",font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER)
TBL <- flextable::set_table_properties(TBL,layout = "autofit")
```
